incident.operation: read-only 3090 nvidia-smi query launched concurrently with a findmnt query to the same SSH alias
incident.error: ssh: connect to host 100.66.29.111 port 22: Operation timed out
incident.concurrent_observation: The findmnt connection to the same host succeeded and confirmed the Arrow SSHFS mount remained read-only.

recovery.action: Retried the GPU query as a single serialized SSH connection with a 10-second connection timeout.

assessment.likely_monitoring_cause: Both observed timeouts occurred only when two SSH connections to 3090 were opened concurrently; in each case one connection succeeded and a serialized retry returned immediately.
assessment.monitoring_change: Future 3090 mount and GPU checks will be serialized rather than issued as concurrent SSH sessions.
assessment.conclusion: This is a repeated monitoring-control connection timeout, not a distributed experiment failure. The failure and the monitoring-method correction are preserved.
